text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Round 1 is over...
Phew... Somehow, I managed to pull it together...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—2000 meters.
Choosing these conditions was definitely the right call.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, it seems most Make Debut races
are 1600m or under.
However—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to choose this distance.
—The 2000m."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's true as well, but—
A longer distance is generally more advantageous for a strategist.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If you trip in a sprint, it's over.
Longer distances give you room to recover,
which helps keep your mental health in check.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thanks to you, I was able to
calmly structure my race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To think an actual race would be this easy to control.
It seems I won't have to fear them from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—upon returning to Tracen Academy, the two of us worked on our next plan.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, as for choosing our next race—
making a decision haphazardly is far too muscle-brained.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What we need to do is...
"work backwards from our ultimate goal."
choice_data_list: Our long-term goal, huh. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Dominating the Twinkle Series."
As a stepping stone to that, the first thing I must accomplish is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I think it means "Classic-class dominance."
choice_data_list: Classic year... that's next year, huh.
Classic year... that's next year, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Classic Year is essentially a rite of passage.
Whoever shines there becomes a candidate for the next ruler.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We're aiming for it.
The Classic Triple Crown.
choice_data_list: The Classic Triple Crown, huh... I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown. It is the collective name for the Classic division's
premier GⅠ races: the Satsuki Sho, the Nippon Derby,
and the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those who conquer these races stand at the pinnacle
of their generation, often going on to claim
hegemony over the era to come.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: First, the opening battle is April's Satsuki Sho, but there are countless routes to get there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's session time, Trainer.
Lay out every card you have in hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I present various routes. First, the route of making the "Satsuki Sho" the immediate goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There's the route going from a Junior Class GⅠ, the route running in a GⅡ right beforehand, and all sorts of others...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see... It seems all the candidates are lined up.
Now then—it is time to make your choice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Out of the routes you've presented, my choice for the best move is—"this one"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What Rulership chose was none other than—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Open race held in the late half of January of the Classic Year.
It's not a GI or GII, not even a graded stakes race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An exceedingly plain choice.
The reason for choosing this place, I imagine, was...
choice_data_list: Could it be you're supposed to "crouch"?
Could it be you're supposed to "crouch"?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, precisely.
As expected, you're quite perceptive.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What I came up with—
is what you'd call "tucking in" in board games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, making it look like she's conceded the contest...
while conserving energy and probing her rival's hand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And then, make your move when the right moment comes.
That's standard practice for us gamers.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The "hand" you hold in a race...
doesn't just mean an Umamusume's "abilities,"
but also includes their "thought habits" and "interpersonal relationships."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Our rivals will lay all of that bare,
while we keep our cards hidden."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daring to hold back. But even if you choose to do so, there are other options besides the Wakagoma Stakes.
choice_data_list: There's also the option of not setting a target race, though.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, complete stealth, huh.
However... that might be pulling back a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Take your eyes off the board for too long,
and reading the flow becomes difficult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's an optimal position in board games.
Not too aggressive, not too defensive—right in the sweet spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, that player snatches the win.
To think she'd apply board game positioning tactics
to this...
choice_data_list: As expected of the great dominare!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, well, coming up with this much is only natural.
For a veteran board gamer, at least.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With our own unique strategy,
we're going to take this Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see what kind of rivals step up.
For now, I'll keep an eye on the whole board.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rulership crosses the finish line now!
That was quite an impressive run.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
We can have high expectations for her future.
Now, moving on to the next race—
Hmm, made a debut without a hitch, did they?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Just how much of a threat—and a worthy rival—could she become to our Rose Clan?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran this race... I feel a resemblance to myself.
Everything was calculated with precise care.
I can hardly wait. Racing on the track with Ruler-san... No—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The day they would truly "connect" as classmates.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is—the Wakagoma Stakes.
From all around, the breathing of the
other players can be heard.
